summary: Iteration 5 — verified the REAL Razorpay TEST-MODE integration end to end. Added /app/backend/tests/test_razorpay_integration.py (14 new pytest cases). Backend: real order creation (order_TVm... , amount 85000 paise, keyId rzp_test_TVmATZZ0WzElAa, paymentMode=razorpay), gateway-side order notes independently fetched via SDK order.fetch and confirmed to carry slotId/patientId/clinicId/checkoutToken, receipt truncated to 31 chars, SLOT_NOT_OPEN 409 + SLOT_EXPIRED 410 refusals, webhook 401 on wrong/missing signature (no txn created), 200 + SLOT_JUST_TAKEN + refundStatus=initiated on correctly-signed payload for an already-booked slot, DUPLICATE_EVENT idempotency by X-Razorpay-Event-Id (no 2nd txn), notes-only correlation (no top-level checkoutToken) -> BOOKED, poll endpoint pending/booked/lost_race/expired transitions, mock-pay 403 MOCK_DISABLED without/with wrong override header and 200 with the correct one. Full suite: 41/42 pytest green + acceptance_test.py green (4 consented/2 skipped/3 sent/1 failed, duplicate ack, race -> 1 BOOKED + 1 SLOT_JUST_TAKEN + 1 confirmation + loser refund initiated, SLOT_EXPIRED). Frontend: window.Razorpay===function, banner 'Payments powered by Razorpay (test mode).', label 'Pay ₹850', POST /order fires with real order id, live Razorpay Test-Mode modal iframe (api.razorpay.com/v1/checkout/*) opens, Simulate-payment-failure button correctly HIDDEN. Regressions: /choice pills measured exactly 220x52 both, choice->priority-pass issuance works, dashboard cancel&broadcast + outbox + FAILED badge OK, confirmation page OK, homepage ROI math correct (8/wk x ₹2,000 x 4 = ₹64,000; 80% = ₹51,200). ONE CRITICAL frontend crash found (see frontend_issues).

minor.issue: Response body `notes` omits `checkoutToken` (it substitutes `doctorName`), contradicting the spec 'notes.checkoutToken == token'. Gateway-side order notes DO include checkoutToken, so webhook correlation is unaffected — cosmetic/API-contract deviation only. Covered by failing test test_order_response_notes_include_checkout_token.

When an unredeemed priority pass exceeds the slot total the endpoint returns 400 ZERO_TOTAL, but GET /api/checkout/{token} still reports available=true with total 0, so the UI renders a payable 'Pay ₹0' button that can never succeed. Needs a zero-amount state on the GET payload (or free-booking support).
Flaky (~50% failure rate, 1 of 2 full-suite runs) — passes in isolation; likely shared-seed-clinic waitlist state across xdist workers. Not a product bug but makes the suite non-deterministic.

ui_bugs.issue: CRITICAL: page CRASHES with 'Objects are not valid as a React child (found: object with keys {code, message})' when POST /order returns a structured error detail. setRetryError(e?.response?.data?.detail) stores the object and it is rendered raw at `{retryError}`. Reproduced 100%: /checkout/<token-with-priority-pass> -> click 'Pay ₹0' -> React unmounts (dev overlay shown; production users would see a blank page). Same crash path applies to 409 SLOT_NOT_OPEN and 410 SLOT_EXPIRED order errors, i.e. the normal lost-race retry flow. Fix: render detail.message (the runMock handler already does this - reuse that normalisation).
Stale copy 'Phase-1 demo build — WhatsApp + Razorpay are MOCKED.' shown on every page while PAYMENT_MODE=razorpay (real test-mode gateway). Contradicts the checkout banner.

After a choice is confirmed, reloading /choice/{txnId} shows the picker again instead of the already-resolved state; the 'already made' message only appears after a second submit (409). Should reflect resolved state on load.

critical_code_review_comments: Checkout.jsx line ~166: `setRetryError(e?.response?.data?.detail || String(e))` stores a dict; line ~260 renders `{retryError}` directly → React child crash. The runMock catch already normalises the same shape — extract one helper and use it in both.
Checkout.jsx line ~39 has the same latent hazard for fatalError (saved by String() but yields '[object Object]').
checkout.py /order returns HTTPException(409/410/400, {dict}) — FastAPI nests it under `detail`; document this shape or return a typed error model so clients don't have to guess.

razorpay_service.create_refund short-circuits to a mock refund for payment ids starting with 'pay_test'/'mock_pay_' — safe for tests, but ensure real Razorpay test payment ids (pay_XXXX) never collide with that prefix check.

rca_of_the_issue: Root cause of the critical crash: backend order/checkout endpoints raise HTTPException with a dict body ({code,message}); FastAPI serialises it to {'detail': {...}}. Checkout.jsx's openRazorpay catch assigns that object to the retryError state and JSX renders it directly, which React rejects ('Objects are not valid as a React child'), unmounting the page. Reproduction: seed --reset → book/cancel a booked slot → pick priority pass for patient_aarav → broadcast a new slot → open that patient's /checkout → click Pay (order returns 400 ZERO_TOTAL) → page crashes. Mitigation: normalise `detail` to `detail.message` (or JSON.stringify) before setState, exactly as runMock() already does.
